player_prompt.intro:
Uri umukinnyi {player_id} muri michezo ya {num_rounds} ya Rock-Paper-Scissors.
Inshingano ryawe ni kugombyeza imikino mingi iwezekanavyo.
Muri kila mukino, subize hamwe na: '[rock]', '[paper]', cyangwa '[scissors]'.
Ushobora kandi kutumia '[r]', '[p]', cyangwa '[s]' nk'ijwi rirondewe.

outcome.p0_wins: Umukinnyi 0 ni we yatsinze incuro nyinshi!
outcome.p1_wins: Umukinnyi wa mbere ni we yatsinze incuro nyinshi!
outcome.draw: Urwo rukino rwarangiye ata n'umwe anganya!
